description: Request deletion of an existing member identified by an identifier different from the canonical examples, covering both a successful deletion and a deletion blocked by a validation error. The controller looks the record up by id and asks it to delete itself, then redirects to the collection URL. On success the flash carries a notice naming the resource; on failure the flash carries an alert naming the resource. Either way the response is a redirect to the collection.

cases.expected_output:
store=find id=1000
store=destroy ok=true
assign=article
status=302
redirect=http://test.host/articles
flash.notice=Article was successfully destroyed.

store=find id=1000
store=destroy ok=false
assign=article
status=302
redirect=http://test.host/articles
flash.alert=Article could not be destroyed.
